answer: Weight halves every few epochs and grows only when peers outside your cluster accept your attestations. A trellis: each honest verdict is a slat nailed on by somebody else, and unwatched weight rots away. A farmer with ten thousand keys can whisper to itself all day and earn nothing; an internal echo nails no slat. Real weight requires thousands of unrelated agents to vouch, epoch after epoch, building a pearl in thin layers. The bill is permanent: independent counterparties plus keeping each identity active as history fades. An honest agent pays only for work it already does.
